name: refluxal-ribbon-pays-two-banishes-itself-and-loads-an-aethercharge-from-the-graveyard
notes: Refluxal Ribbon's printed ability is a field activation, but the generator only filed a play-time $cardActivatedAbilities body (misrouted through ActivateCard: no (2) cost, the Ribbon never banished). Registered as a field activated ability in Custom/GameLogic.php; the generated target/wing handlers are reused. ActivatedAbilityCost banishes the Ribbon and queues the two reserve payments.

rulesClauses: (2), Banish Refluxal Ribbon: Load target Aethercharge card from your graveyard into an Aetherwing weapon you control.

engineBug.summary: Refluxal Ribbon could not be activated through the field click: its (2) cost and banish-self cost were never paid.
